---
title: "Exercise 1 · Your First Agent Session"
subtitle: "Specify a task, watch the agent work, review the result"
---

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**Time:** ~10 min · **Pairs with:** [Prompting & Directing](../prompting.qmd) · **Goal:** feel the specify → act → review loop on a small, real task.
:::

## Setup (1 min)

Make a fresh scratch folder and start the agent:

```bash
mkdir agentic-ex1 && cd agentic-ex1
claude
```

## Task (do it twice — vague, then specified)

We'll generate a tiny synthetic dataset and a summary, so everyone has something concrete to review.

### Round 1 — a vague prompt
Type this to the agent, exactly as-is:

```text
make me some fake patient data and summarize it
```

Watch what it does. It will *work* — but notice all the choices it made *for* you (columns, size, format, what "summarize" means).

### Round 2 — a specified prompt
Now ask for what you actually want:

```text
Create an R script `make_data.R` that generates a synthetic dataset of
200 patients with columns: id, age (18–90), sex (M/F), treatment
(control/drug), and cost (positive, right-skewed). Save it to
data/patients.csv. Then create `summarize.R` that prints mean cost by
treatment arm and saves a colorblind-safe bar chart of it to
figs/cost_by_arm.png. Show me each script before running it.
```

## Practice the loop

- When it proposes a script, **read it** before you let it run. Does it do what you asked?
- Ask it to **run** the scripts and show you the output and the figure path.
- Give one piece of **specific feedback**, e.g.:
  ```text
  Make the cost distribution more skewed (use rgamma), and add
  value labels on the bars.
  ```
- Notice how a precise correction lands in one turn.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Try a plan-first prompt
Before round 2, you can add: *"Before writing anything, tell me your plan and which files you'll create."* Approve it, then let it go. This is the habit we formalize with git next.
:::

## You're done when…

- [ ] You ran both the vague and the specified prompt and can articulate the difference in results.
- [ ] `data/patients.csv` and `figs/cost_by_arm.png` exist and look right.
- [ ] You gave at least one specific correction and the agent applied it.
- [ ] You **read** at least one script *before* it ran.

## Reflect (30 sec)

What did the vague prompt get wrong that the specified one fixed? That gap is the value you add as the director.
